text:
Sam Nguyen: Thanks everyone — quick live thread from the runtime section. Two quick asks: (1) can we get a short summary of the KV cache eviction strategy we're planning for v3? (2) kernel rollout order — which models first?
Mira Patel: For KV eviction: LRU with size-tiered TTLs as default, but policy will be configurable per route. goal is to keep hot prefixes across short sessions.
Jon Brooks: +1 on per-route TTL. also we should expose a metric for 'cache-hit-by-prefix-age' so product can tune prompts.
Liu Chen: curious about memory compaction cadence — will eviction be synchronous on insert or background GC?
Mira Patel: background compaction by default; synchronous eviction only when we hit hard memory threshold to avoid p99 spikes.
Ava (Product): can we get an example config snippet we can show customers?
Mira Patel: sure — example:
```
cache:
  algorithm: lru
  max_items: 200000
  prefix_tiers:
    - max_age: 30s
      fraction: 0.6
    - max_age: 5m
      fraction: 0.3
    - max_age: 30m
      fraction: 0.1
```
This is illustrative. we plan to surface via `redwoodctl route update --cache` later.
Sam Nguyen: kernel rollout q: are we doing decoder-only 8k first, then MQA quantized variants, or mixing? any risk of regressions we should flag early?
Jon Brooks: plan is: 1) stable decoder-only 8k FP16 kernels -> smoke tests, 2) quantized path (4-bit) on canary, 3) add MQA kernels for mixed-precision ops. keep older kernels as fallbacks.
Liu Chen: for canary, what traffic split? also which metrics will auto-fail the rollout?
Mira Patel: default canary 1% for 24h, 5% for 6h if green. auto-fail if latency p99 > baseline + 20ms or error rate > 0.5% or perplexity/regression on the eval set crosses threshold.
Ava (Product): who owns the eval set? we need to coordinate to add a couple of customer prompts for better signal.
Sam Nguyen: @Ava I'll sync with you and @Jon — we can add a customer prompt bucket flagged as 'sensitive' for internal-only evals.
eng-bot: Deploy started: kernel-v3-canary -> us-west-2 (canary=1%)
Jon Brooks: heads up — if you see any p99 spikes please paste traces here. keep replies short so eng leads can triage.
Liu Chen: noted. I'll add dashboards: cache_hit_ratio by prefix_age, kv_evictions/sec, kernel_load_utilization.
Mira Patel: followups: we'll publish a short runbook on rollback triggers + manual kill switch. ETA EOD tomorrow.
Sam Nguyen: awesome. thanks all — action items: Jon add canary perf alert, Liu add dashboards, Ava supply prompt set, Mira publish runbook.
Ava (Product): on it. :thumbsup:
Jon Brooks: working on alerts now.
Liu Chen: dashboards created, linking in #eng-runtime shortly.
Sam Nguyen: closing thread — feel free to reply if anything blocks.
